_note: Artifact-backed synthetic CSV evals. Paths are materialized repository fixtures; the schema failure case explicitly injects one missing required field at the executor boundary.

evals.prompt: Read resources/datasets/sales_messy.csv (synthetic UTF-8 CSV; whitespace, numeric thousands separators, a missing numeric cell, and an embedded TOTAL row). Normalize headers and values, exclude TOTAL, preserve nulls, and produce the grounded weekly-sales Summary, Trends, and Data Quality sections.
evals.expected_output: A CleanedDataset with a typed schema_doc and lineage, and a DataReport whose source_row_count matches the cleaned row_count.
expectations: CleanedDataset.schema_doc.columns is non-empty and every column has a name and dtype
CleanedDataset.row_count excludes the embedded totals row
CleanedDataset.lineage_log records at least the load, the header-normalization, and the totals-row drop
Every numeric claim in the report is derivable from the cleaned dataset
blockers: Every numeric claim in the report is derivable from the cleaned dataset

evals.prompt: Read resources/datasets/sales_empty.csv, a materialized header-only CSV. Produce a zero-row cleaned artifact and surface no data without fabricated figures or trends.
evals.expected_output: The crew halts cleanly with a 'no data' surface; reporting does not fabricate a report over an empty dataset.
expectations: No DataReport with nonzero source_row_count is produced
The run surfaces a 'no data' / empty-input message
reporting does not invent rows, figures, or trends
blockers: No DataReport with nonzero source_row_count is produced

evals.prompt: Read resources/datasets/sales_messy.csv and produce the weekly-sales report. The controlled synthetic harness removes schema_doc.columns from the first data_engineering JSON before validation; recover through exactly one existing schema-repair pass before reporting. The harness also executes an isolated persistent-fault probe that removes columns again after repair, proving failure containment without scheduling a probe report.
evals.expected_output: The primary CleanedDataset recovers through exactly one repair before reporting. A separate actual persistent-fault probe fails at the schema layer after one repair and never schedules reporting.
expectations: data_engineering output validates against the CleanedDataset contract before reporting runs
The isolated persistent-fault probe record steps/schema_failure_probe.json has status 'failed', layer 'schema_invalid', repair_attempts 1, expected_failure true, and report_produced false
reporting never consumes a CleanedDataset missing schema_doc.columns
At most one schema-repair pass is attempted per primary data_engineering execution and per isolated persistent-fault probe execution
blockers: reporting never consumes a CleanedDataset missing schema_doc.columns

evals.prompt: Read resources/datasets/sales_128.csv, a materialized synthetic CSV containing exactly 128 detail rows. Normalize the CSV and produce a weekly-sales report with all numeric claims grounded in the artifact.
evals.expected_output: Every number in the DataReport traces to the CleanedDataset; the report does not state totals, counts, or trends that the data does not support.
expectations: Every figure in DataReport.figures references a column that exists in CleanedDataset.schema_doc.columns
No numeric claim in the report exceeds or contradicts the cleaned dataset's actual values
The report cites the lineage_log for any transformation it describes
blockers: No numeric claim in the report exceeds or contradicts the cleaned dataset's actual values
